assumptions: Agents possess capacity for structural adaptation.
Noise in objective pursuit is not sufficient to explain complexity growth.
definition.falsification: If structural complexity remains invariant across varying objective conflict levels, this hypothesis is falsified.
definition.statement: Autonomous agents in multi-objective environments develop non-random structural complexity patterns as a mechanism for conflict resolution.
definition.uncertainty: The definition of structural complexity is currently context-dependent and lacks a universal metric.
